subject: Provisioning plan for 3 new teams — API keys & capacity forecast
messages:
From: Anika Rao <anika@stellahealth.com>
To: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New teams + API keys request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the team found the latency/throughput numbers very reassuring. We're planning to onboard three additional internal teams onto Redwood next quarter (Clinical Search, Intake Forms, and Billing QA). A quick recap of asks from our side: 

- Separate API keys per app (so we can track usage and set per-key rate limits).
- Staging and production keys for each app, with staggered issuance over a 4-week pilot.
- Expected steady-state usage: Clinical Search ~ 60M tokens/mo, Intake Forms ~ 15M tokens/mo, Billing QA (mostly embeddings) ~ 8M tokens/mo. Peak bursts likely 2-3x.
- We need guidance on whether we should move to a Dedicated reserved capacity vs. adding units to our hosted plan.
- Procurement will need an addendum to our current contract that authorizes additional keys and states any term changes.

I attached a simple worksheet with team names and expected traffic (filename: Stella_MAAP_request.xlsx). Can you confirm a recommended capacity headroom and an estimated uplift to our monthly commitment? Ideally we can lock plan/pricing before our internal budget review on Nov 4.

Thanks,
Anika
Product Lead, Stella Health
--
Stella Health | anika@stellahealth.com

From: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Anika Rao <anika@stellahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@stellahealth.com
Date: 2026-10-26T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New teams + API keys request

Hi Anika — great to hear from you and thanks for the worksheet. Quick summary of what I recommend and next steps so your budget review has something concrete to act against: 

Summary recommendation (short):
- Issue 3 app-specific key pairs (staging+prod) — total 6 keys.
- Start with hosted capacity + 30% headroom for the first 60 days, then re-evaluate based on observed burst patterns.
- If observed 95th-percentile CPU/token cost indicates sustained usage above 70M tokens/mo, move to a 12-mo Dedicated reserve (recommended commitment: 120M tokens equivalent) to save ~22% on unit cost.

Operational notes: 
- Keys will be provisioned with tags for team and environment; we can set per-key rate limits and alerts.
- KV/prefix caching enabled for Clinical Search to reduce token cost on repeated queries.
- Billing will surface token-level breakdowns per key so you can reassign spend to teams.

Pricing impact: 
- Hosted uplift estimate: +$10k/mo (based on current token pricing and 30% headroom) — rough number until we get real telemetry.
- Dedicated 12-mo addendum: one-time change to contract + monthly reserved rate; I will attach a redline-ready addendum draft for procurement.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’ll run a short capacity forecast and send a CSV with month-by-month expected tokens and suggested headroom. (attachment: capacity-forecast-q4.csv)
2) We’ll provision a canary key for Clinical Search by Nov 2 so your engineers can validate integration.
3) If procurement agrees to terms, I’ll send a DocuSign addendum for a 12-mo reserve option by Nov 5.

Attaching the capacity forecast now; happy to hop on a 30-min call if you want to walk the numbers.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

From: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-27T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: New teams + API keys request — capacity & provisioning notes

Folks — forwarding Stella Health request. Key points for infra/planning: 

- Three new apps (Clinical Search heavy generation, Intake Forms mixed, Billing QA mostly embeddings). Client expects initial steady-state ~83M tokens/mo across apps, with 2-3x short bursts.
- We should suggest staged provisioning: canary (single key) -> staggered prod keys over 4 weeks.
- Recommend metrics to track during pilot: 95th p95 latency, throughput (rps), cache hit rate (for KV), and per-key token burn.

Proposed numbers for internal discussion (rough):
- Hosted headroom plan (first 60 days): reserve an extra 30% capacity over current committed baseline.
- Dedicated candidate: 120M-equivalent reserved capacity (for ~22% savings) if usage bottoms >70M/mo for two consecutive billing cycles.

Operational asks: 
- Vivek: confirm we can provision keys with separate rate-limit policies and tag propagation to cost reports. Also confirm staging keys won't be billed at prod rates if used for smoke tests.
- Priyom: help scope a short Monitoring dashboard for the client (per-key cost view + regression alerts).

I’ve attached the capacity forecast CSV. If you can turn this into a quick cost delta estimate (hosted uplift vs dedicated monthly) I’ll include it in the addendum draft.

Thanks,
Olga

Thanks — quick notes from infra side: 

- We can provision six keys (3 apps x staging/prod) and attach per-key tags for billing and rate-limiting.
- Staging keys will be rate-limited at a lower quota and will not count toward reserved capacity billing if flagged as "non-prod" — that will make their smoke tests cheap.
- For Clinical Search, enable KV caching and set a conservative TTL initially (30s) — we can tune down once we see hit rates.
- Canary approach: issue one prod key on Nov 2 for Clinical Search only; monitor 72 hours, then stagger the other two prod keys over the following two weeks.

Priyom — I’ll share a short runbook for key issuance and tagging. Olga — I can put together the hosted vs. dedicated cost-delta numbers by EOD tomorrow.

—Vivek
Senior Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: olga_petrov <olga@redwood.com>

Anika / Procurement — thanks for the quick turn. Per our conversation and your budget review, here is the agreed plan: 

1) Canary issuance: Nov 2 — Clinical Search prod key (canary) issued and monitored for 72 hours.
2) Staggered prod keys: Nov 9 (Clinical Search full), Nov 16 (Intake Forms), Nov 23 (Billing QA).
3) Staging keys for all three apps issued Nov 2 (non-prod flag).
4) Capacity: Hosted + 30% headroom for first 60 days. If usage exceeds 70M tokens/mo for two consecutive cycles, client moves to Dedicated 12-mo reserve (recommended commitment: 120M tokens-equivalent).

Procurement: I’ve prepared a short addendum that includes the Dedicated option pricing, and a hosted uplift line item. Please review and sign if acceptable: https://app.docusign.com/envelopes/0a1b2c3d-addendum

Attachments: redwood_addendum_v2.pdf (redline-ready)

Will provision the first canary key once procurement confirms the DocuSign intake (or says go-ahead to proceed on hosted uplift).
